result.brief: 提出潜空间3D高斯记忆（每个高斯存VAE潜特征），可直接渲染进DiT潜空间，与视频扩散Transformer自回归交替更新，实现实时、长时序空间一致的交互式世界生成。
result.reason: Interactive action-conditioned video world model with latent 3D Gaussian memory rendered directly into DiT latent space, avoiding VAE re-encoding; real-time long-horizon spatial consistency.
